summary: Adopter guide for moving heavy CI jobs off the PR path without weakening required checks.
migration_impact: Optional read for adopters reshaping CI; no workflow import required. Sync the doc via gh plate import-payload when upgrading plate-core.
migration_guidance: Read docs/migration/ci-cd-split-guidance.md before removing OS matrices or installer jobs from PR workflows.
Keep branch protection on labels, test, and pr-gates; do not require contexts that skip on pull_request.
When one workflow serves PR and post-merge, add a PR success step before deferring heavy work.
Run post-merge or release pipelines after integration merges to catch platform-specific regressions.
